description: This file defines the ReporterV2 interface and a wrapper class for handling test reporting in the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for various test lifecycle events, error handling, and output streaming, as well as a function to wrap reporters as version 2.

classes.name: ReporterV2Wrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps a Reporter to implement the ReporterV2 interface, handling deferred output and method forwarding.

methods.name: wrapReporterAsV2
methods.description: Function to wrap a Reporter or ReporterV2 as a ReporterV2 instance, returning the reporter directly if already v2.
